summary: Inseego closed its purchase of Nokia Solutions and Networks Oy's fixed wireless access business, paying 1,163,693 Inseego shares, warrants on 521,139 shares, and assumed liabilities; Nokia simultaneously invested $10M cash for 775,795 shares plus warrants on 290,569 shares, giving Nokia roughly 11% of Inseego pre-warrant exercise. Warrant strike was reset to $4.26, the 30-trading-day VWAP through September 25, 2026. An amendment adds a $10M Nokia cash payment by October 15, 2026, funding device-OS interoperability engineering. Terms rest entirely on stock and cash, with no stated premium. Watch Nokia's ~11% stake, warrant overhang, and integration execution.
